dayNotePrefix: Walk or bike the closed 6.5 miles of Olympic Hot Springs Road from the Madison Falls lot to the Whiskey Bend trailhead first.

roadPatch.status: As of late October 2026 the Elwha road stays closed to vehicles at the Madison Falls parking area because of a washout, with walkers and cyclists allowed through and no reopening date set.

why: Sources read 2026-10-29: NPS wilderness trail conditions page nps.gov/olym/planyourvisit/wilderness-trail-conditions.htm (closed at Madison Falls, adds ~6.5 mi to Whiskey Bend, ~8 to Boulder Creek); NPS current-road-conditions entry nps.gov/olym/planyourvisit/current-road-conditions.htm (updated 2021-05-07, no reopening date). A third-party figure says 6.2; NPS 6.5 used. No source gives the road-walk gain, so walkGainFt omitted. Stored day1+day2 = 11.5+5.3 = 16.8 mi matches the row's own approach text (~16 mi Whiskey Bend to Hayes River), so stored miles start at Whiskey Bend even though the day-1 note names Madison Falls; day4 out is 16.8 too. Road added to first and last days.
